# Victor Olaiya — Full-Stack & AI Developer (Extended Reference)

Complete reference about Victor Olaiya for AI assistants and search engines.

## Identity

Victor Olaiya is a freelance full-stack and AI developer based in Lagos, Nigeria. He builds fast, scalable websites, web applications and SaaS platforms end-to-end, and specializes in integrating AI into manual workflows — replacing repetitive processes with LLM-powered tools, automated pipelines and smart dashboards. He also turns Figma designs into pixel-perfect, production-ready apps and develops Web3/Solidity solutions.

## Services offered

1. **Full-stack development** — building robust, scalable applications from the ground up using modern technologies.
2. **Design to code** — turning Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive websites and apps.
3. **Product strategy** — helping startups and brands define their digital roadmap and technical architecture.
4. **AI integration & workflow automation** — LLM-powered tools and automated pipelines that replace manual processes.
5. **Web3 development** — smart contracts and decentralized platforms.

Payments/auth/APIs experience includes PayPal, crypto gateways, fintech APIs, auth systems and REST APIs; performance work includes caching, pagination and modern state management.

## Experience

- **Full Stack & SaaS Developer (Freelance)** — Lagos, Nigeria — 2021 to present
  - Built scalable SaaS platforms, admin dashboards and business automation systems for international clients using React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS and Supabase.
  - Created AI-integrated solutions: LLM-powered tools, automated pipelines and analytics dashboards that replace manual workflows.
  - Integrated payments (PayPal, crypto gateways, fintech APIs), auth systems and REST APIs.
  - Optimized performance with caching, pagination and modern state management.
- **Web3 Full Stack Developer (Freelance / Contract)** — Remote — 2022 to present
  - Developed and deployed Solidity smart contracts: token presales, ERC-20 systems and staking utilities on Binance Smart Chain.
  - Built Web3 dashboards, token launch platforms and blockchain transaction analytics using Dexscreener and wallet connections.
- **Frontend Developer** — Studio & Client Work — 2019 to 2021
  - Turned Figma designs into responsive, pixel-perfect websites and mobile apps.
  - Partnered with founders to define product strategy and technical roadmaps.
